NEU.evidence: Handles surprising and potentially pressured situations calmly and confidently—firmly states boundaries (“stop saying numbers”), rejects without visible anxiety, and speaks with composure.

OPN.evidence: States a desire for work that is “more than a job” and something he can “really care about,” prioritizing meaning over money—indicative of openness to new, fulfilling paths.
